text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos.  One original fictional adult man. White European man with inky-black medium layered swept-back hair and two loose forehead strands, pale blue-gray eyes, cool dramatic romantic charm, black matte high-collar leather jacket. Facial design: broad oval face rather than a narrow sculpted face, shorter midface, round-ended substantial chin, gently curved medium brows, slightly wider eye spacing, short straight nose with rounded tip, wide mouth with full lower lip. Fair neutral skin, natural beauty, no resemblance to any reference face. Black matte leather standing-collar jacket over black tee, black slim straight jeans and black leather ankle boots. Broad-shouldered lean 189cm build. Exactly three equally spaced full-body views of ONE SAME person in one horizontal row: strict FRONT at left, strict 90-degree SIDE profile facing image-left in center, strict 180-degree BACK at right. Consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, shoes and 8.5-head tall long-limbed anatomy. Relaxed straight upright stance arms by sides. Every figure fully visible from hair to soles with margin, identical height, same baseline. Pure white ground, narrow white gutters, landscape 3:2. No text. Tall lean athletic male fashion-model anatomy with approximately 8.5 anatomical head lengths from skull crown to bare-foot soles. Head excluding hair volume is about 11.8% of total standing height. Long legs and arms, proportionate shoulders and waist, normal neck length, natural muscle definition. Do not elongate the face or neck or use shoe soles to fake height. Straight camera with no foreshortening.
